leadText: (Japanese: がんばってピカチュウ! Good Luck, Pikachu!) is the first bonus chapter in the Pokémon Chamo-Chamo ☆ Pretty ♪ manga. It is listed as a "sister story" to Chamo-Chamo ☆ Pretty ♪ and focuses on Hazel and the other main characters of Magical Pokémon Journey.
